person.name: In Dover Morris
person.notes: Obituary Record: Interment at Fork Branch Cemetery

obituaries.full_text:
MORRIS: In Dover, Del on Oct. 29, 
1964
. Elizabeth C. Morris, aged 81 years. Relatives and friends are invited to attend the services at the Immanuel Union Church, Cheswold, Delaware on Sunday afternoon, Nov. 1, at 1 o'clock. Interment at Fork Branch Cemetery. Friends may call at the Stevenson Funeral Home, Dover, Del. on Saturday eveneing from 7 to 9 p.m.

Orlenard Morris  
Aug. 17,
1966
